Tallest indoor waterfall
The 40-meter-tall HSBC Rain Vortex, the world's tallest indoor waterfall, is located in
the Jewel complex at Changi Airport, Singapore.
It is encircled by the Shiseido Forest Valley, home to about 2,500 trees and 100,000
shrubs that help regulate the air.
The Skytrain linking Terminals 2 and 3 glides past the falls, and each evening the
cascade becomes a music-synced light show.
Changi has also been voted one of the world's best and most modern airports for
many years.
